sentences.en: Where is the train station?
sentences.alt: Where can I find the railway station?

sentences.zh: 我要买一张去北京的火车票。
sentences.en: I want to buy a train ticket to Beijing.
sentences.alt: I would like a ticket to Beijing by train.

sentences.en: What time does the train leave?
sentences.alt: When does the train depart?

sentences.zh: 我们的火车在几号站台？
sentences.en: Which platform is our train on?
sentences.alt: What platform does our train leave from?

sentences.zh: 这趟火车晚点了二十分钟。
sentences.en: This train is twenty minutes late.
sentences.alt: The train is delayed by twenty minutes.

sentences.en: I am waiting for you in the waiting room.
sentences.alt: I will wait for you inside the station hall.

sentences.en: Excuse me, where is the ticket office?
sentences.alt: Where is the ticket counter, please?

sentences.en: I should get off at the next station.
sentences.alt: I need to get off at the next stop.

sentences.en: Do I have to change trains on the way?
sentences.alt: Must I change trains during the trip?

sentences.en: There are many empty seats in the carriage.
sentences.alt: The carriage has a lot of free seats.

sentences.zh: 我明天早上坐飞机去上海。
sentences.en: I am flying to Shanghai tomorrow morning.
sentences.alt: I will take a plane to Shanghai tomorrow morning.

sentences.zh: 我们的航班在几号登机口？
sentences.en: Which gate is our flight at?
sentences.alt: What gate does our flight leave from?

sentences.zh: 请出示你的护照和登机牌。
sentences.en: Please show your passport and boarding pass.
sentences.alt: Show me your passport and boarding pass, please.

sentences.zh: 飞机将在十分钟后起飞。
sentences.en: The plane will take off in ten minutes.
sentences.alt: The aircraft is leaving in ten minutes.

sentences.en: Our flight has been cancelled.
sentences.alt: They cancelled our flight.

sentences.zh: 我在机场免税店买了礼物。
sentences.en: I bought gifts at the airport duty-free shop.
sentences.alt: I got some presents in the duty-free store.

sentences.en: There is a long queue at security.
sentences.alt: You have to wait a long time at the security check.

sentences.zh: 我的航班延误了两个小时。
sentences.en: My flight is delayed by two hours.
sentences.alt: My plane was two hours late.

sentences.en: Please board at gate three.
sentences.alt: Boarding is at gate number three, please.

sentences.en: I cannot find the baggage claim area.
sentences.alt: Where is the place to collect luggage?

sentences.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?
sentences.alt: Excuse me, which way is the museum?

sentences.zh: 一直往前走，然后向右转。
sentences.en: Go straight ahead and then turn right.
sentences.alt: Walk straight on and turn right.

sentences.en: The bank is next to the post office.
sentences.alt: The bank is beside the post office.

sentences.en: The supermarket is on the other side of the road.
sentences.alt: The supermarket is across the street.

sentences.en: Is it far from here to the train station?
sentences.alt: Is the railway station far away?

sentences.en: It takes about ten minutes on foot.
sentences.alt: It is about a ten-minute walk.

sentences.zh: 在第二个红绿灯处左转。
sentences.en: Turn left at the second traffic light.
sentences.alt: Take the second left at the lights.

sentences.zh: 你能给我看地图上的位置吗？
sentences.en: Can you show me the place on the map?
sentences.alt: Could you point it out on the map?

sentences.en: I am afraid I am lost.
sentences.alt: I think I have lost my way.

sentences.zh: 请带我去最近的地铁站。
sentences.en: Please take me to the nearest subway station.
sentences.alt: Can you direct me to the closest metro station?

sentences.en: I have booked a double room.
sentences.alt: I reserved a room for two people.

sentences.en: I am staying for two nights.
sentences.alt: I will stay two nights here.

sentences.en: Please give me your passport.
sentences.alt: May I see your passport, please?

sentences.en: Is breakfast included in the price?
sentences.alt: Does the room price include breakfast?

sentences.en: My room is on the fifth floor.
sentences.alt: I am in a room on the fifth floor.

sentences.en: The lift is at the end of the corridor.
sentences.alt: The elevator is at the end of the hall.

sentences.en: I am checking out at eight tomorrow morning.
sentences.alt: I will leave the hotel at eight tomorrow morning.

sentences.zh: 房间里的无线网密码是什么？
sentences.en: What is the wifi password in the room?
sentences.alt: Could you tell me the room wifi password?

sentences.zh: 我可以把行李寄存在这里吗？
sentences.en: Can I leave my luggage here?
sentences.alt: May I store my bags here?

sentences.en: Please give me one more towel.
sentences.alt: Could I have another towel, please?

sentences.en: Please call a taxi for me.
sentences.alt: Could you order a taxi, please?

sentences.en: I want to go to the train station.
sentences.alt: Take me to the railway station, please.

sentences.en: How much does it cost to get to the airport?
sentences.alt: How much is the fare to the airport?

sentences.en: Please stop here.
sentences.alt: You can stop right here.

sentences.en: Can you drive a little faster?
sentences.alt: Could you please hurry up?

sentences.en: Please give me a receipt.
sentences.alt: I need a receipt, please.

sentences.en: I am in a hurry.
sentences.alt: I am running late.

sentences.zh: 这个城市的出租车很干净。
sentences.en: The taxis in this city are very clean.
sentences.alt: Taxis here are quite clean.

sentences.zh: 司机帮我把行李放进后备箱。
sentences.en: The driver helped me put my luggage in the boot.
sentences.alt: The driver put my bags in the trunk for me.

sentences.en: I pay the fare in cash.
sentences.alt: I will pay for the ride with cash.

sentences.en: Which bus goes to the city centre?
sentences.alt: Which bus should I take downtown?

sentences.en: The bus stop is in front of the supermarket.
sentences.alt: The stop is outside the supermarket.

sentences.zh: 我每天早上坐公交车上班。
sentences.en: I take the bus to work every morning.
sentences.alt: I go to work by bus every morning.

sentences.zh: 这辆车每十五分钟一班。
sentences.en: This bus comes every fifteen minutes.
sentences.alt: There is a bus every quarter of an hour.

sentences.en: Please buy a ticket when you get on.
sentences.alt: Buy your ticket as you board, please.

sentences.en: I should get off at the third stop.
sentences.alt: My stop is the third one.

sentences.en: There are no seats left on the bus.
sentences.alt: The bus has no free seats.

sentences.en: Please give your seat to an old person.
sentences.alt: Let elderly people take your seat, please.

sentences.en: The next stop is People's Park.
sentences.alt: We are arriving at People's Park next.

sentences.en: The last bus is at ten in the evening.
sentences.alt: The final bus leaves at ten at night.

sentences.en: We are visiting the old town today.
sentences.alt: Today we will see the old city.

sentences.en: How much is this ticket?
sentences.alt: What does one ticket cost?

sentences.zh: 我们可以在这里拍照吗？
sentences.en: Can we take photos here?
sentences.alt: Is it allowed to take pictures here?

sentences.en: This tower is one hundred metres high.
sentences.alt: The tower is a hundred meters tall.

sentences.zh: 导游给我们讲了很多故事。
sentences.en: The guide told us many stories.
sentences.alt: Our guide shared a lot of stories with us.

sentences.en: The view from here is beautiful.
sentences.alt: You can see a lovely view from here.

sentences.en: The museum opens at nine.
sentences.alt: The museum is open from nine o'clock.

sentences.en: I bought a map of the city.
sentences.alt: I got a city map.

sentences.zh: 我们排队等了半个小时。
sentences.en: We waited in line for half an hour.
sentences.alt: We queued for thirty minutes.

sentences.en: This is my favourite place.
sentences.alt: This place is my favorite one.

sentences.en: My suitcase is very heavy.
sentences.alt: My luggage weighs a lot.

sentences.en: I only have a backpack.
sentences.alt: I have just one rucksack.

sentences.en: Please put your luggage on the scale.
sentences.alt: Put your bag on the scales, please.

sentences.en: My luggage is overweight.
sentences.alt: My bags weigh too much.

sentences.en: I lost a suitcase.
sentences.alt: One of my cases is missing.

sentences.en: My camera is in this bag.
sentences.alt: I keep my camera inside this bag.

sentences.en: I packed three shirts.
sentences.alt: I put three shirts in my case.

sentences.en: Please help me with my luggage.
sentences.alt: Could you carry my bags for me?

sentences.en: I locked my suitcase.
sentences.alt: My luggage is locked now.

sentences.en: Please keep your valuables with you.
sentences.alt: Carry your valuable things yourself, please.

sentences.en: I want to buy two return tickets.
sentences.alt: I would like two round-trip tickets.

sentences.en: How much is a single ticket?
sentences.alt: What is the price of a one-way ticket?

sentences.en: Do students get a discount?
sentences.alt: Is there a student discount?

sentences.en: Can I book tickets online?
sentences.alt: Is it possible to book a ticket on the internet?

sentences.en: This seat is already taken.
sentences.alt: Someone is sitting in this seat.

sentences.zh: 我要换一张早一点的车票。
sentences.en: I want to change to an earlier ticket.
sentences.alt: I would like to exchange this for an earlier one.

sentences.en: Please collect your ticket half an hour early.
sentences.alt: Pick up your ticket thirty minutes before, please.

sentences.en: This ticket is valid today.
sentences.alt: You can use this ticket today.

sentences.en: I left my ticket at home.
sentences.alt: I forgot my ticket at home.

sentences.en: The ticket check is on the second floor.
sentences.alt: Tickets are checked upstairs on the second floor.

sentences.en: I want to rent a car.
sentences.alt: I would like to hire a car.

sentences.en: How much does it cost for one day?
sentences.alt: What is the price per day?

sentences.en: Do I need to show my driving licence?
sentences.alt: Must I show a driver's license?

sentences.en: Does the price include insurance?
sentences.alt: Is insurance part of the rental price?

sentences.en: Please return the car with a full tank.
sentences.alt: Fill the tank before you bring it back.

sentences.en: Is this car automatic?
sentences.alt: Does this car have an automatic gearbox?

sentences.en: Can I return the car at the airport?
sentences.alt: Is it possible to drop the car off at the airport?

sentences.en: The return time is written in the contract.
sentences.alt: The contract shows when to bring the car back.

sentences.zh: 车子里有两个安全座椅。
sentences.en: There are two child seats in the car.
sentences.alt: The car comes with two safety seats.

sentences.en: Please sign here.
sentences.alt: Sign your name here, please.
